text.README.md: Explains delegate installation, bundled tooling, the host skills that own credentials and pull requests, the permissions snippet, the complex variant (an Opus or Fable delegate the user picked for a heavy task) and its checks, and differences from the upstream workflow
text.SKILL.md: Orchestrates bounded background Claude delegates on the Sonnet ladder (a task it judges heavy goes to the user as one Sonnet, Opus or Fable question, and to the complex variant only on their answer) through preflight, the once-per-project choice of PR delivery (pr, push or local), review, map verification (reasons, order and flow of the PR record, or of the local branch record when there is no host PR, the flow's file links included) and handover with the record already in the project and carried again before the worktree goes, reads its own required skills and the orchestrator slot of the user's extras from the list command for its role, which the skill-use gate checks in its own session, leaves the delegate slot out of the brief, appends a Conventions block to the brief when the gate prints a skill linker path, and runs an approved plan item by item from `Plan: <slug>`; Codex sessions use the Codex reference instead
text.SKILL.md @ skills/lantern-delegate-compl: where a heavy task goes once the user picked Opus or Fable
text.SKILL.md @ skills/lantern-delegate/scrip: reads the orchestrator and delegate extra-skill slots
text.SKILL.md @ skills/lantern-plan-handoff/S: holds the detail of delegating from a plan
text.protocol.md @ skills/lantern-delegate-co: the reviewer a Fable delegate uses
text.protocol.md: Guides a Claude delegate through isolated implementation (reading the skills its list command prints: the bundled core skills the user has not switched off plus the delegate slot of the user's extras), obeying the brief's delivery (pull request through the host skill, push only, or local), independent review (by a Fable reviewer for a Fable delegate, which like an Opus delegate does the whole run, the Lantern work included) and verified map and PR handover (keeping the shared feature and outside-system lists), the PR record, or with no host PR a local branch record, carrying reasons, review order, a flow whose steps point at the changed files behind them and the plan item it ticks; Codex delegates follow the Codex reference
